mainEntity.name: When should I ask about refund rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should ask before proceeding if anything about payment boundaries, cancellation, or service stages feels unclear.

mainEntity.name: Does Immigrate to Brazil explain payment boundaries before work begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is the goal. Clients should understand how payment and refund boundaries work before they commit, not only after a problem arises.

mainEntity.name: Can I ask questions about refund terms before paying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If you need clarity first, ask. Clear expectations are part of a safer and more professional service relationship.
Requests are handled through a review of the specific payment and service stage involved, rather than through assumptions or informal promises.

mainEntity.name: Where should I contact the team about a refund or payment concern?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the contact details provided for the site or the relevant payment-related page so the issue can be reviewed properly.
